_comment: Shared backend-to-LLM project context. Training messages with role project or memory carry the corresponding object as JSON-string content. The LLM engine owns rendering, slot adoption and token budgets; Rust owns source authorization and retrieval.

project.name: Conversation storage
project.description: Keep conversation persistence and ownership consistent.
project.notes: Use PostgreSQL and preserve applied migrations. Keep every conversation private to its owner.

memories.memory: Commit the completed assistant message before acknowledging success to the browser.
